hook: Your health history has dates. Why shouldn't you see it like a story?
caption:
Your health history is full of dates. In the daily health diary, each date becomes a paper report you can flip through, open and read in full: pulse 59 BPM at 5:14 PM, fingertip 61 BPM, six logs one tap away. A physical archive of days, not a list of cards. #HealthGraph #HealthDiary #DailyReport #HealthHistory #SelfTracking #Wellness #HealthData #Longitudinal #PersonalData #MindfulHealth
Explore the health diary.

lines.text: Your health history has dates. Why shouldn't you see it like a story?
lines.beat: Establish the physical archive: a stack of cream paper daily reports (daily-report card style) rises in depth, explicitly a paper archive, not a card list

lines.text: Each day becomes its own paper report in your daily health diary.
lines.beat: Cut to the stack: many cream paper pages, each with a date spine on its edge, warm paper texture

lines.text: Not a folder of files, but a stack you can flip through.
lines.beat: Stack continues on screen: paper reports, physically stacked with depth, deliberately no card list, no app grid
Fingers scroll the paper-report stack; pages slide past with soft page turns
Stack pauses on the 3 OCT page; the selected paper report lifts out of the stack

lines.text: The report rises from the stack.
lines.beat: Selected paper report rises out of the stack toward the camera, other pages settling behind

lines.text: It opens, and the day shows itself.
lines.beat: Paper report opens like a page, revealing the real daily-report card: 3 OCT Today, Daily Report, Saturday, October 3; crop the user name

lines.text: Pulse: 59 beats per minute, fair, at 5:14 PM.
lines.beat: Open report: focus on the real Pulse 59 BPM Fair 5:14 PM line on the daily-report card

lines.text: Then the fingertip reading: 61 beats, the same day.
lines.beat: Focus slides down to the real ALSO Pulse Fingertip 61 BPM Fair line on the same open report

lines.text: Six logs sit behind it, one tap away.
lines.beat: Footer Log ×6, tap to open glints on the daily-report card, then dims back

lines.text: Every day on its own page, in the right order.
lines.beat: Pull back to the full paper-report stack: the archive, dates in order, the opened day visible on top
End card: CTA over the softly focused paper-report stack, warm charcoal background
